name: Rise of the Silithid
summary: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser sends you to Darnassus with a report for Gracina Spiritmight, a night elf scholar and historian.

sections.title: A Scholar in Darnassus
sections.body: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser wants the report in the hands of someone who knows such matters. Gracina Spiritmight is a night elf scholar and historian. She has spent much time studying life forms unique to Azeroth's ecology. Fizzledowser hopes she can judge the danger and find a way to halt it. At Fizzledowser's last word, Gracina lives in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

sections.title: Gracina's Answer
sections.body: Gracina Spiritmight says the night elves know of the terror described in the report. She believes Fizzledowser chose well in sending the report, and you. The silithid will devour the Tanaris desert rapidly and rank among the greatest menaces anyone will face. They are tools of one of the gravest threats to both Horde and Alliance. Gracina laments that no one saw the danger sooner.

faq.answer: Gracina Spiritmight is a night elf scholar and historian who has spent much time studying life forms unique to Azeroth's ecology.

aliases: where did the report come from
faq.answer: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser gives you the Insect Analysis Report and asks you to take it to Gracina Spiritmight.

faq.q: Where can Gracina Spiritmight be found?
faq.answer: At Fizzledowser's last word, Gracina Spiritmight lives in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

faq.q: What came before this journey to Darnassus?
aliases: what led to rise of the silithid
faq.answer: Insect Part Analysis comes before your journey to Darnassus.
